lines.line: Well, ever since you walked away, my life ain't never been the same
The porch light's on, but you ain't here
Your old cup's still by the mirror
Every night I talk to ghosts in the quiet
You're the one I miss the most
Now the nights get colder, the days feel long
I keep hearing echoes of our old song
A shadow of a man with your name on my soul
Can't find the light in this empty home
The hound dog howls at the break of dawn
He still waits by the fence, you're gone
Neighbors ask if I'm doing fine
Now the nights get colder, the days feel long
I keep hearing echoes of our old song
A shadow of a man with your name on my soul
Can't find the light in this empty home
Maybe time will dull the stain
But it cuts deep like a winter rain
I trade this pride, this worn out heart
Just to get one more brand new start
This house is filled with fear and doubt
I swear I see a dress swinging on that line
But it's just the wind playing tricks on my mind
Now the nights get colder, the days feel long
I keep hearing echoes of our old song
A shadow of a man with your name on my soul
Can't find the light in this empty home
Ever since you walked away, my life ain't never been the same
